blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Human Rights Watch (HRW) has warned that the planned construction of a technology manufacturing hub under the US-led Pax Silica initiative could displace Indigenous communities and small farmers in Tarlac. “Indigenous communities and small farmers fear they will be unlawfully displaced by the semiconductor hub,” Lian Buan, HRW Southeast Asia researcher, said on Wednesday, urging the government to “follow domestic laws and international standards that protect land rights.” HRW said it visited two potentially affected areas in Capas, Tarlac, last month — Sapang Kawayan in Barangay Aranguren and Sitio Binyayan in Barangay O’Donnell — where it interviewed 11 […]...
